title: Mirabel and the Garden
author: Dominic Sterling
blurb: Vesper Reyes, a cartographer of unmapped realms, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
